resources.string: Block distracting apps in split screen
Detects blocked apps in split screen during focus sessions. Accessibility access is required; detection can vary by device.
Block distracting apps in floating windows
Detects blocked apps in picture-in-picture and floating windows during focus sessions. Accessibility access is required; detection can vary by device.
